notes: PATCH: Evidence Status / Fact Gate cho PHF AI Read Hub. Khong mo tool moi, khong doi nghiep vu module - chi them metadata evidence:{status,source,asOf,note} do BACKEND gan (lib/ai-tool-registry.js#buildEvidence) vao MOI structured result truoc khi dua cho DeepSeek/UI. VERIFIED khi tool lay du lieu thanh cong tu source of truth trong pham vi da neu ro o note (vd get_checklist_lowest_employees/search_employees luon canh bao 'KHONG dai dien cho toan bo nhan vien PHF' vi nguon chi la checklist_employee_assignments - dung Rule 6). INCOMPLETE khi thieu input, khong tim thay (get_employee_profile/get_knl_profile not-found nay tra card INCOMPLETE thay vi null truoc day), hoac thieu quyen/du lieu (vd get_checklist_violation_summary khi canView=false). CONFLICTED: contract + UI badge + system prompt da san sang nhung CHUA co tool nao trong repo tao ra trang thai nay that (khong co 2 nguon doc lap de doi chieu) - test bang mock qua buildEvidence() (da export) va renderStructuredCard() phia frontend de xac nhan contract dung khi co tool sinh CONFLICTED trong tuong lai. System prompt (lib/ai-sandbox.js) bo sung hard rule: khong duoc nang INCOMPLETE/CONFLICTED thanh ket luan chac chan, khong tuyen bo du lieu PHF neu khong co tool evidence, VERIFIED van phai bam dung so lieu tool (khong tu suy luan sua so), va cau tra loi mang tinh danh gia/de xuat (dù VERIFIED) phai gan nhan 'Nhan dinh AI:'/'Goi y AI:'. Frontend assets/js/ai/phf-ai-engine.js: them badge 3 trang thai (khong dung % confidence gia tao) + hien thi evidence.note ngay duoi card, va tag '✦ Nhan dinh AI'/'✦ Goi y AI' khi cau tra loi bat dau bang nhan do. 32 test moi (20 backend + 12 frontend) deu PASS, khong sua file nghiep vu Checklist/KNL/Classroom/Training Hub/Auth/Router nao.
